limitations: Synthetic browser state only. No API, database, uploads, notifications or clinical record was changed.
Scoped staff checkout/return authority and canonical record-link/projection contracts still need implementation approval.
Resource availability is a controlled source simulation, not a live reservation engine.
Actual browser zoom remains unverified; desktop resizing checked at 1024, 1280, 1440 and 1920 pixels.
Whole-application/backend security and repository CI were not exercised by these preview tests.
